name: LHMKE
description: LHMKE is a large-scale, holistic, multi-subject knowledge evaluation benchmark designed to comprehensively assess Chinese large language models' knowledge acquisition capabilities. It contains 10,465 questions across 75 tasks covering 30 subjects from primary school to professional certification exams, including both objective and subjective questions.
reputation: A recent Chinese knowledge benchmark that is cited in work on broad subject coverage, but it is not yet a widely standardized leaderboard in the broader LLM community.
notes: Benchmark includes subjective questions and evaluates zero-shot performance; also analyzes GPT-4's ability to automatically score subjective answers.
